name: Forensics / File Analysis
description: Isolated sealed-file identification, hashing, similarity, hardening, and YARA inspection.
help_text: Operator Mode binds one or two sealed DDK uploads by ID/hash and runs exact file, hashdeep, ssdeep, checksec, or YARA argv with time/output limits and an authenticated report artifact. Arbitrary router paths, process/PID scanning, tracing, and debugger attachment remain outside this file-only action.
